title: Put Together Flat Shapes
sourceStudentTask: Build and TRACE one composite pattern-block shape, record number of blocks. Rebuild SAME outline with DIFFERENT pattern blocks, record new count, optionally maximize pieces.

teacherRubric.required: Learner uses actual flat pieces edge-to-edge, traces the resulting composite boundary, records the number of constituent blocks and describes their shapes.
The teacher validates defining geometric attributes, correct counts or decompositions, and a mathematical explanation consistent with the learner's own actual drawn/composed object.
The source requires a physical or drawn representation and verbal or recorded work. Naming a shape or number digitally is a partial assessment only.
The teacher can examine authentic learner-produced drawings or tracings only after these occur during learning; readiness of the rubric does not imply observed real student work.

Teacher independently checks original and reconstructed objects have the same outer silhouette but different component arrangements and individually recorded block counts; optional maximizing number of blocks is explicit.
